mission: Use existing research and open-source systems as learning references while building independently implemented, benchmarkable improvements for music and video production.
principles: Learn from capabilities, not by copying protected implementation code.
Record licenses and provenance for every external reference.
Reimplement ideas independently when the license and law permit; otherwise integrate only through permitted interfaces.
Create DreamCo-specific benchmarks that test capabilities rather than implementation similarity.
Turn benchmark gaps into research hypotheses and experiments.
Prefer measurable improvements over feature-count growth.
Publish useful benchmark methodology and open-source improvements when licensing permits.

music: increase controllability without reducing musical quality

benchmark_policy.external_benchmarks: Use when licensing and access permit.
benchmark_policy.dreamco_benchmarks: Maintain proprietary/controlled holdouts for gap discovery.
benchmark_policy.capability_comparison: Compare measured behavior and failure modes, not source-code similarity.
benchmark_policy.score: Every major capability receives 0-100 percentage scores and evidence.
